verdict.rationale: Release-changelog generation is a fair question for a work-management platform that links GitHub/GitLab pull requests, but the evidence never documents generating a changelog per release. The closest items are adjacent: scheduled status and performance reports, PR-to-item linking, and generic custom agent and app building blocks. None of these is a release changelog capability.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can auto-generate a changelog for each release so shipping progress is easy to review
